title: Oaths, Declarations and Notarisations (Remote Methods) Bill
what_it_is: Oaths, Declarations and Notarisations (Remote Methods) Bill

sections.label: Electronic oaths and notarisations
sections.summary: The Bill amends several Acts to enable statutory declarations, oaths, affirmations and notarisations by electronic means while ensuring integrity and security against fraud.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: This Bill amends the Oaths and Declarations Act, the Notaries Public Act and other Acts, to enact a framework that will enable statutory declarations, oaths and affirmations, and notarisations to be done through electronic means, while ensuring the integrity of these processes and maintaining a high degree of security against fraud.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: This Bill is linked to the Constitution (Amendment) Bill, which we had earlier debated.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: In that debate, I have already explained the amendments proposed in both Bills.
